description: Symbol-name mismatch between behavioral-spec REQ-P4 and verification-architecture Purity Boundary table for the test-only ed25519 keypair fixture. behavioral-spec.md line 73 defines `fixture_ed25519_keypair(tmp_path)`; verification-architecture.md line 18 defines `generate_test_keypair(tmp_path) -> (privkey_pem_path, pubkey_b64)`. Both docs are in scope of THIS iteration-1 spec review, and the two names refer to the same test-only I/O helper. An implementer cannot pick a unique canonical symbol — this is precisely the class of ambiguity that produced sprint-1 FIND-006 (which REQ-A1 is trying to fix). The spec must pick one name and use it in both files, and specify the return contract in both places.

evidence.snippet: REQ-P4: A test-only fixture `fixture_ed25519_keypair(tmp_path)` SHALL generate a temp keypair for tests. vs verification-architecture.md L18: `generate_test_keypair(tmp_path)`
